{{Youmay|the suspended animation capsule|the [[suspended-animation casket]]}}
A '''suspended animation capsule''' was a type of device that could be used to put individuals into [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]]. Shortly prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Ra-Zyrth]] and a number of top [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] were placed into suspended animation capsules. During the [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Coruscant]] the Sith fired the capsules and their occupants into the [[City/Legends|cityscape]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
